title: [E16-01] Pure Domain State, Money and Quantity Invariants
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-01 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to model domain states and money as pure tested functions, so I can prevent inconsistent operations.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P0  
**Target Release:** A — Phase 1 validation — 5 November 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-043  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P0`, `release:A`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** None at story level.
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: None.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Unit tests for transitions, decimal amounts and allocation invariants.
- [ ] Encode guarded RFQ/order/offer/batch/payment transitions independently of UI.
- [ ] Implement exact TND arithmetic with documented rounding and units.
- [ ] Enforce allocation, production, QA and settlement reconciliation invariants.
- [ ] Test valid/invalid paths, boundary amounts, duplicate operations and impossible quantities.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Create shared TypeScript domain modules with no persistence side effects; NestJS commands invoke them within transactions.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Run meaningful unit/property-style cases for decimal rounding, illegal transitions, excess allocation and QA reconciliation.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
